sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: Unpredictable things happen to us all the time.
sentences.zh: 不可预测的事情总是发生在我们身上。

sentences.en: Those little moments shift the direction of your day or your week.
sentences.zh: 这些小插曲改变了你这一天或这一周的走向。

sentences.en: And then there are the bigger things in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中还有更重大的变故。

sentences.en: The earthquake kind of change that shakes everything around you,
sentences.zh: 那种地震般的改变，撼动了你周围的一切，

sentences.en: that breaks down your sense of who you are and what your life is.
sentences.zh: 打破了你对自己是谁以及生活是什么的认知。

sentences.en: And in the process of getting back on your feet,
sentences.zh: 而在重新站起来的过程中，

sentences.en: you might realize that something's different.
sentences.zh: 你可能会意识到有些东西变了。

sentences.en: Maybe you come out of it with a new perspective,
sentences.zh: 也许你从中获得了一种新的视角，

sentences.en: a sense of direction you never imagined.
sentences.zh: 一种你从未想象过的方向感。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we have two stories of that kind of change
sentences.zh: 今天的节目里，我们将讲述两个关于这种改变的故事，

sentences.en: Oh, and we have some pretty beautiful music that comes with those stories.
sentences.zh: 哦，这些故事还伴随着一些非常美妙的音乐。

sentences.en: Derek Amado is sitting at the piano in NPR Studio One.
sentences.zh: 德里克·阿马多正坐在 NPR 一号演播室的钢琴前。

sentences.en: As you're listening to him play, you might think he's had years of musical training.
sentences.zh: 当你听他演奏时，你可能会以为他受过多年的音乐训练。
但德里克的情况很不寻常。

sentences.en: He's said to have something called acquired savant syndrome
sentences.zh: 据说他患有一种叫做“后天学者综合征”的病症，

sentences.en: that left him with the incredible ability to play the piano.
sentences.zh: 这让他拥有了不可思议的钢琴演奏能力。

sentences.en: We'll talk about what that means, but let's back up a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们会讨论这意味着什么，但让我们先回顾一下过去。

sentences.en: I grew up a typical kid.
sentences.zh: 我从小就是一个典型的孩子。

sentences.en: I was an extremely aggressive athlete, so that was kind of my thing.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常有进取心的运动员，那是我的强项。

sentences.en: I was a baseball, football, basketball player.
I had musical interest from very early on.
sentences.zh: 我很早就对音乐产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: My grandmother was a organ player for the church.
sentences.zh: 我祖母是教堂的管风琴手。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I was around it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我一直耳濡目染。

sentences.en: I remember Sunday mornings going, sitting next to her on the bench.
sentences.zh: 我记得周日早上会坐在她旁边的长凳上。

sentences.en: And even though I didn't understand what she was doing or how to play the instrument,
sentences.zh: 尽管我不明白她在做什么，也不懂怎么演奏乐器，

sentences.en: I loved to sit with her and sing, and it was just my comfort zone as a child.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢坐在她身边唱歌，那是我童年的舒适区。

sentences.en: When I go to church, I get to sit and watch her play the organ and sing.
sentences.zh: 我去教堂时，就能坐着看她弹管风琴、唱歌。

sentences.en: At his mother's insistence, Derek dabbled in music.
sentences.zh: 在母亲的坚持下，德里克涉足了音乐。

sentences.en: He joined the school band, played drums, tinkered around with a guitar,
sentences.zh: 他加入了学校乐队，打过鼓，摆弄过吉他，

sentences.en: formed a rock band with friends.
sentences.zh: 还和朋友组建过摇滚乐队。

sentences.en: But he did not take formal lessons or get any musical training.
sentences.zh: 但他从未接受过正规的课程或任何音乐训练。

sentences.en: What happens to Derek in 2006 is both terrifying and fascinating.
sentences.zh: 2006 年发生在德里克身上的事既可怕又迷人。

sentences.en: He was in South Dakota visiting friends and family.
sentences.zh: 当时他在南达科他州探望亲友。

sentences.en: I got together with some friends,
sentences.zh: 我和一些朋友聚在一起，

sentences.en: and we were going to have a little barbecue party at the pool, an indoor pool.
sentences.zh: 我们打算在泳池边开个烧烤派对，那是个室内泳池。

sentences.en: And we were horsing around, and this young man walked in.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在打闹，这时有个年轻人走了进来。
他大概 14 岁，或者 12 到 14 岁之间，

sentences.en: and he had this little miniature football with him.
sentences.zh: 他带着一个小型的橄榄球。

sentences.en: So, of course, we started throwing the football at each other.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们自然就开始互相扔那个橄榄球了。

sentences.en: And I thought I could just run on the side of the pool
sentences.zh: 我以为我可以沿着泳池边跑，

sentences.en: and then dive over the water and catch the football in the air.
sentences.zh: 然后跳过水面，在空中接住橄榄球。

sentences.en: And the idea was you would catch it and then fall into the pool?
sentences.zh: 你的意思是接住球然后掉进泳池里？

sentences.en: Yeah, just catch it in the air and then fall into the water.
sentences.zh: 对，就是在空中接住它，然后掉进水里。

sentences.en: So I went running on the side of the pool,
and I remember running alongside the pool.
I remember even diving in to catch the ball.
sentences.zh: 我还记得自己跳水去接球。

sentences.en: And I knew I was diving towards a shallow end.
sentences.zh: 我知道我跳向的是浅水区。

sentences.en: And I miscalculated the depth, obviously,
and I hit the upper left side of my face.
sentences.zh: 我的脸左上侧撞到了东西。
之后我就什么都不记得了。

sentences.en: And, you know, most of us have had a head trauma when we were a kid
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们大多数人在小时候都受过头部创伤，

sentences.en: or hit our head, and it's that sickening feeling you get when it's like,
sentences.zh: 或者撞到过头，那种感觉很糟糕，就像是，

sentences.en: I just did something extremely wrong, and this isn't right.
sentences.zh: 我刚才做了件极其错误的事，这不对劲。

sentences.en: And I knew I had hurt myself.

sentences.zh: 诊断结果是严重脑震荡。

sentences.en: Lay in bed for a few days.
I spent the night at the hospital, and the next morning they sent me home.
sentences.zh: 我在医院住了一晚，第二天早上他们就让我回家了。

sentences.en: I went home, and I slept.
I slept for five days, basically.
And then you get up and do what?
sentences.zh: 然后你起床后做了什么？

sentences.en: We're sitting at the table, and I said,
well, I feel pretty darn good.
I know I had an accident, and I'm not sure what happened.
sentences.zh: 我知道我出了事故，但不确定发生了什么。

sentences.en: And I said, well, I'm going to pack,
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我要收拾行李了，

sentences.en: and I think I can go back to Denver in a couple days.
sentences.zh: 我想过两天就能回丹佛了。

sentences.en: So I called Rick, and I said, why don't you come over and get me?
sentences.zh: 于是我给里克打了电话，说，你过来接我好吗？

sentences.en: We'll say goodbyes, and I'll be on my way in a couple days.
sentences.zh: 我们道个别，过两天我就出发。

sentences.en: And so we went over to his apartment, and we were just hanging out.
sentences.zh: 我们去了他的公寓，就在那儿闲逛。

sentences.en: And he had this tiny keyboard, just this little piece of junk in the corner,
sentences.zh: 他有一个小键盘，角落里的一件破烂玩意儿，

sentences.en: and it was just on the stand, dusty, and not sure if it had ever been played.
sentences.zh: 它就在架子上，落满了灰，不知道有没有人弹过。

sentences.en: And I kept staring at it as we were talking,
sentences.zh: 我们聊天的时候，我一直盯着它看，

sentences.en: and we were just sitting talking, just like this.
And I kept looking at it and looking at it, curious.
sentences.zh: 我一直看着它，带着好奇。

sentences.en: I was like, not sure why I was drawn to it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么会被它吸引。

sentences.en: And I finally just walked over to it, and I thought,
sentences.zh: 最后我径直走过去，心想，

sentences.en: I'll just hit a few of these keys.
I turn it on and see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我把它打开，看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: And I sat down, and my fingers just went crazy.
sentences.zh: 我坐下来，手指就开始疯狂地动起来。

sentences.en: My fingers were like somebody just, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 我的手指就像被什么人，我不知道，

sentences.en: Rick said the ghost of Beethoven jumped into my body.
sentences.zh: 里克说贝多芬的灵魂跳进了我的身体。

sentences.en: I don't know how else to explain it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还能怎么解释。

sentences.en: I went crazy and just played and played,
sentences.zh: 我疯了一样不停地弹奏，

sentences.en: and it wasn't like I was just picking away.
sentences.zh: 那感觉不像是我在胡乱敲击。

sentences.en: I played, I think it was more of the,
it had this more of a classical structure to it.
sentences.zh: 它有一种更古典的结构。

sentences.en: And I sat there and did this for, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 我就坐在那儿弹了，我不知道，

sentences.en: And we just, I remember looking at him,
and there was tears rolling down his face.
sentences.zh: 泪水顺着他的脸颊流了下来。

sentences.en: I mean, he's a Christian kid.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是个基督徒孩子。
他是个感情很丰富的人。
他是个非常非常善良的人。

sentences.en: And he just, he didn't know what to think as,
sentences.zh: 他只是，他不知道该想什么，

sentences.en: because, I mean, I've known him since we were kids.
sentences.zh: 因为，毕竟我们从小就认识。

sentences.en: And he'd never seen me play a piano.
sentences.zh: 他从来没见过我弹钢琴。

sentences.en: So he's like, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 所以他觉得，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I'm not sure what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我也不确定是怎么回事。

sentences.en: I didn't want to stop playing because I was like,
sentences.zh: 我不想停止弹奏，因为我在想，

sentences.en: well, what if I stop and then this doesn't happen tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 万一我停下来，明天早上这种能力就没了怎么办？

sentences.en: I mean, this is kind of cool.
I don't, I mean, it doesn't happen every day.
sentences.zh: 我不，我的意思是，这种事不是每天都会发生的。

sentences.en: You just sit down and start playing a piano.
sentences.zh: 你不能随随便便坐下来就开始弹钢琴。

sentences.en: So I think this is kind of different.
Let's just stay here for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们就在这儿多待一会儿吧。

sentences.en: It must've been two o'clock in the morning and I was exhausted.
sentences.zh: 当时一定是凌晨两点，我精疲力竭。

sentences.en: My brain was flying, still was racing.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑还在飞速运转，依然很兴奋。

sentences.en: And so he took me back to my mother's house.
sentences.zh: 于是他把我送回了我母亲家。

sentences.en: We had a call of the day.
I was, you know, beat up.
sentences.zh: 我当时，你知道，被打垮了。

sentences.en: And I went to bed and the next morning I woke up and I was,
sentences.zh: 我上床睡觉，第二天早上醒来时，

sentences.en: I was like, how am I going to tell my mother,
sentences.zh: 我在想，我该怎么告诉我的母亲，

sentences.en: the person that knows me best on this planet?
sentences.zh: 这个世界上最了解我的人？

sentences.en: I just hit my head and I'm a little whacked out.
sentences.zh: 我刚撞了头，现在有点神志不清。

sentences.en: How am I going to tell her that I just discovered that I know how to play the piano fairly well
sentences.zh: 我该怎么告诉她，我刚发现自己居然能弹得一手好钢琴，

sentences.en: to a person that's known me my entire life, 40 years.
sentences.zh: 告诉一个认识我一辈子、整整 40 年的人。

sentences.en: So I said, well, I don't know any other way than to take her to a music store.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，除了带她去乐器店，我别无他法。

sentences.en: So I said, we had a cup of coffee and I said,
sentences.zh: 于是我说，我们喝了杯咖啡，我说，

sentences.en: let's run to the music store real quick.
And she said, what do you want to buy?
I said, I just want to show you something real faSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，我只是想很快地给你看样东西。

sentences.en: We get to the music store.
The salesman says, I don't know, like, you know, he's going to help you.
sentences.zh: 售货员说，我不知道，你知道，他想帮忙。

sentences.en: He wants to sell me something.
And I said, if you show me how to get this piano, this digital piano on,
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你能教我怎么打开这架钢琴，这架数码钢琴，

sentences.en: And then give me just 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 然后给我 10 分钟时间就行。

sentences.en: So he turns it on, shows me how to turn the darn thing on.
sentences.zh: 于是他把它打开，教我怎么把那玩意儿启动。

sentences.en: I tell my mother to sit down next to me.
sentences.zh: 我叫我母亲在我旁边坐下。

sentences.en: I don't quite remember what I played that time,
sentences.zh: 我不大记得当时弹了什么，

sentences.en: but I was doing more of a, I wanted to sing to her for some reason
sentences.zh: 但我当时更多的是，不知为何我想为她唱歌，

sentences.en: because it was such an emotional thing.
And I was going into like, and I just started to kind of chord this.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像是，开始尝试弹奏和弦。

sentences.en: And she was looking at me like, whoa, when did this transpire?
sentences.zh: 她看着我，一脸惊讶，心想这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I mean, she had all kinds of questions right away.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她当时立刻就有一堆问题。

sentences.en: And then I just kind of went nuts and started going crazy just to show her,
sentences.zh: 然后我就有点失控了，开始疯狂弹奏，只是为了向她展示，

sentences.en: well, look at this, look at this.
It was a very quiet drive home.
As you're telling me this, Derek,
I almost have the feeling that you are pulling my leg right now
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得你是在跟我开玩笑，

sentences.en: because it seems this is not possible.
sentences.zh: 因为这看起来根本不可能。

sentences.en: This is just simply not, it could not have happened.
sentences.zh: 这简直，这根本不可能发生。

sentences.en: You know, well, if I would have had my way,
sentences.zh: 你知道，好吧，如果由我决定的话，

sentences.en: I'm not sure if I would have ended up a piano player.
sentences.zh: 我不确定自己最后会成为一名钢琴演奏者。

sentences.en: I kind of wanted to be a baseball player
sentences.zh: 我本来想成为一名棒球运动员，

sentences.en: and I work in the fighting business.
sentences.zh: 而我是在格斗行业工作的。

sentences.en: I invite skepticism because I think when something so beautiful
sentences.zh: 我欢迎质疑，因为我认为当如此美丽

sentences.en: and profound happens, we have to question.
sentences.zh: 且深刻的事情发生时，我们必须提出疑问。

sentences.en: At what stage did you stop questioning that you had a skill?
sentences.zh: 你在哪个阶段不再怀疑自己拥有这项技能了？

sentences.en: I'm assuming that you were skeptical as well.
sentences.zh: 我猜你当时也持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I mean, you told me that when you went home the first night,
sentences.zh: 我是说，你告诉我第一天回家时，

sentences.en: you were afraid that it was going to be a one-day skill
sentences.zh: 你很担心这只是一天的技能，

sentences.en: and it was going to be gone by the next morning.
At what point did you stop questioning it and say,
sentences.zh: 你在什么时候停止了怀疑，并说，

sentences.en: this is actually a new skill that I have?
sentences.zh: 这确实是我拥有的新技能？

sentences.en: You know, I think you kind of grow into that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得你是慢慢适应了，

sentences.en: getting comfortable with accepting what's transpired in your life.
sentences.zh: 开始习惯接受生活中发生的一切。

sentences.en: I definitely didn't want it to go away.
In the first year or two, it was a little, you know,
like I would wake up thinking, I need to get to a piano.
sentences.zh: 就像我会醒来想，我得找架钢琴。

sentences.en: I need to make sure it's still here.
And as time went on, I started to understand that,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我开始明白，

sentences.en: well, the doctors tell me it can go away as fast as it came.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉我，它可能来得快去得也快。

sentences.en: And acquired musical savant syndrome, that means you've acquired a gift.
sentences.zh: 而后天获得的学者综合症，意味着你获得了一份天赋。

sentences.en: And I got to that point where I just accepted the fact that
sentences.zh: 我到了那个阶段，我只是接受了这个事实，

sentences.en: I'm going to enjoy every second of this.
sentences.zh: 我要享受其中的每一秒。

sentences.en: Because if I wake up tomorrow and it's gone,
sentences.zh: 因为如果明天醒来它消失了，

sentences.en: I want to be able to say that I did the best I could to display it
sentences.zh: 我希望能够说，我尽我所能向社会展示了它，

sentences.en: to a society looking in at my life and say,
sentences.zh: 让审视我生活的人们看到，

sentences.en: I've been inspired by this, or the human potential is amazing,
sentences.zh: 我受到了启发，或者人类的潜力是惊人的，

sentences.en: or the brain is just a magnificent, you know,
sentences.zh: 或者大脑只是一个宏伟的，你知道，

sentences.en: organ that we don't know anything about.
And I think it became that comfort knowing that
sentences.zh: 我认为这种舒适感源于我知道

sentences.en: I'm going to enjoy it every single second.

sentences.zh: 如果它留下来，那太美好了。

sentences.en: If it goes away, then I guess I'll go get a job.
sentences.zh: 如果它消失了，那我想我会去找份工作。

sentences.en: Have you spoken to a neurologist who is skeptical about what's happening to you?
sentences.zh: 你有没有咨询过对你身上发生的事情持怀疑态度的神经科医生？

sentences.en: I think they're all skeptical the moment they walk in the door.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们一进门就都持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I know that you're a nice guy.
You seem like a trustworthy person.
sentences.zh: 你看上去是个值得信赖的人。

sentences.en: But I have the feeling that you're just,
this is just one big giant prank.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个巨大的恶作剧。

sentences.en: I'm articulate and I still have most of my marbles.
sentences.zh: 我能言善辩，而且我大部分理智还在。

sentences.en: So I can, I can display the story in a different way than,
sentences.zh: 所以我可以，我可以以一种不同的方式展示这个故事，而不是，

sentences.en: let's say the guy that hit his head and woke up a piano player,
sentences.zh: 比如那个撞到头醒来后成为钢琴家，

sentences.en: If I asked you to play Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star for me,
sentences.zh: 如果我让你为我弹奏《一闪一闪小星星》，

sentences.en: I don't think I can play it.
I tried to do Happy Birthday for a person the other day
sentences.zh: 前几天我试着为一个人弹《生日快乐歌》，

sentences.en: and I couldn't figure it out.
Is that this one right here?
Where was that first note then?
So it's all up and down.
I see, I see, I can see it now.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，我明白了，我现在能看出来了。

sentences.en: Thanks for the first note though.
sentences.zh: 不过还是谢谢你给的第一个音符。

sentences.en: But it's sort of an interesting thing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这真是一件有趣的事情，不是吗？

sentences.en: Which is like, you don't go up,
you don't see someone who says,
you know, I can throw a fastball at, I don't know, 140 miles an hour,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以以每小时140英里的速度投出快球，

sentences.en: but I don't know how to reach out and shake your hand.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道怎么伸手和你握手。

sentences.en: And to me, you're displaying musical ability at one end of the spectrum,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你在光谱的一端展示了音乐天赋，

sentences.en: whereas playing Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, I can do that.
sentences.zh: 而弹奏《一闪一闪小星星》，我能做到。

sentences.en: And I find it just really difficult to understand how you can be so good at the extreme end.
sentences.zh: 我真的很难理解你怎么能在极端的一端表现得如此出色，

sentences.en: Does it worry you that you have this ability?
sentences.zh: 拥有这种能力会让你担心吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm a Christian kid, so I think this is where God wants me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我是个基督徒，所以我认为这是上帝希望我所在的位置。

sentences.en: I think this has already been penned out, my story.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的故事早已注定。

sentences.en: I mean, I have to live with this every day,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我每天都得带着这个生活，

sentences.en: so if I sit and beat my own mind up about is this nature versus nurture and nature and all this nonsense,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我坐下来纠结这是先天还是后天，以及所有这些废话，

sentences.en: but I mean, I've talked to the best doctors, the smartest doctors on this planet,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我和这个星球上最好的医生、最聪明的医生谈过，

sentences.en: and they all got a different little input,
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都有不同的看法，

sentences.en: and they all got something different to say about it.
sentences.zh: 对这件事都有不同的说法。

sentences.en: Most all of them are skeptic when I walk in,
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人在我进去时都持怀疑态度，

sentences.en: and most all of them when I walk out are right here with me.
sentences.zh: 而大多数人在我出来时都和我站在一边。

sentences.en: Have any of them suggested treatments?
sentences.zh: 他们中有人建议过治疗方法吗？

sentences.en: Dr. Reeves at the Mayo Clinic, when I was filming with the Discovery Channel,
sentences.zh: 梅奥诊所的里夫斯医生，我在拍摄探索频道节目时，

sentences.en: he was fascinated with this as well,
and he said the best way for him to explain it is like a roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 他说他能解释的最好方式就像过山车。

sentences.en: If you get on a roller coaster that doesn't stop,
sentences.zh: 如果你坐上一辆不停的过山车，

sentences.en: sooner or later it's going to get tiring.
So maybe we suggest slowing down the stimulant,
sentences.zh: 所以也许我们建议减缓这种刺激，

sentences.en: You're firing these neurons at a pace that's unheard of.
sentences.zh: 你的神经元以一种闻所未闻的速度放电。

sentences.en: So let's try some seizure medication to shut those down, right?
sentences.zh: 所以让我们尝试一些抗癫痫药物来抑制它们，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know, understand how it works,
sentences.zh: 我不知道，也不理解它是如何工作的，

sentences.en: but I do know it slows down the firing of the neurons.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道它减缓了神经元的放电。

sentences.en: Oh, why would I want to take synthetic drugs
sentences.zh: 哦，我为什么要服用合成药物，

sentences.en: and mask something possibly that I'm enjoying to the point
sentences.zh: 去掩盖我正在享受的东西，以至于

sentences.en: where I don't want it to slow down or go away?
sentences.zh: 我不想让它减慢或消失？

sentences.en: I'll take the hyperness and the ADHD and the OCD
sentences.zh: 我宁愿接受随之而来的亢奋、多动症和强迫症，

sentences.en: and all that garbage that comes with this maybe.
What if it has a consequence where you are burning your brain
sentences.zh: 如果它有一个后果，就是你在以一种对你不健康的水平

sentences.en: at a level that is not healthy for you?
I mean, so for example, let's say...
I guess I go down on fire, baby.
sentences.zh: 我想我会带着火焰倒下，宝贝。

sentences.en: And that's how the story ends, and I'm good with that.
sentences.zh: 故事就是这样结束的，我对此没意见。

sentences.en: You're still the guy who would die for the football over the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 你还是那个会为了游泳池里的橄榄球而拼命的人。

sentences.en: Of course, Derek Amato isn't the only person with acquired savant syndrome.
sentences.zh: 当然，德里克·阿马托并不是唯一患有后天学者综合症的人。

sentences.en: Others have experienced the profound changes that come with this condition.
sentences.zh: 其他人也经历了这种疾病带来的深刻变化。

sentences.en: They are in love with what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 他们热爱自己所做的事情。

sentences.en: It's almost like an extension of who they are.
sentences.zh: 这几乎像是他们自身的一种延伸。

sentences.en: Also, I'm going to challenge Derek to play the studio wall.
sentences.zh: 另外，我要挑战德里克弹奏录音室的墙壁。

sentences.en: I see on this wall, I see these squares.
sentences.zh: 我在这面墙上看到了这些方块。

sentences.en: Some of them have different depths,
sentences.zh: 其中一些有不同的深度，

sentences.en: so the full squares almost feel like a whole note to me.
sentences.zh: 所以完整的方块对我来说几乎感觉像是一个全音符。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam, and you're listening to Hidden Brain from NPR.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·维丹塔姆，你正在收听的是 NPR 的《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: This week on the show, we're looking at the specific moments people lose something big
sentences.zh: 本周节目，我们将探讨人们失去重要事物的那一刻，

sentences.en: and how that change can point them in new directions.
sentences.zh: 以及这种改变如何指引他们走向新的方向。

sentences.en: Before the break, Derek Amato told us the story of how he became a musician after a head injury.
sentences.zh: 节目开始前，德里克·阿马托讲述了他如何在头部受伤后成为一名音乐家的故事。

sentences.en: Before the accident, he couldn't play the piano.
sentences.zh: 事故发生前，他根本不会弹钢琴。

sentences.en: But after, his musical talent was just undeniable.
sentences.zh: 但事故之后，他的音乐天赋变得显而易见。

sentences.en: If this is the first time you're hearing our show, I have a confession to make.
sentences.zh: 如果这是你第一次收听我们的节目，我得坦白一件事。
我是一个彻头彻尾的理性主义者。

sentences.en: When surprising things happen, I don't call them miracles.
sentences.zh: 当令人惊奇的事情发生时，我不会称之为奇迹。

sentences.en: But I found myself asking over and over how something like this could happen.
sentences.zh: 但我还是忍不住反复思考，这样的事情怎么可能发生。

sentences.en: That's when I came by a couple of researchers who've spent years
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我接触到了几位研究人员，他们花了多年时间

sentences.en: studying people who've suddenly acquired savant-like gifts.
sentences.zh: 研究那些突然获得类似学者症候群天赋的人。

sentences.en: Daryl Treffert is a psychiatrist in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 达里尔·特雷弗特是威斯康星州的一位精神科医生。

sentences.en: And I must say that in his case, I was as startled as you
sentences.zh: 我必须说，就他的案例而言，我和你们一样感到震惊，

sentences.en: about the fact that he went to the piano and knew where to place his fingers and so forth.
sentences.zh: 因为他走到钢琴前，竟然知道手指该放在哪里等等。

sentences.en: The reason that I'm inclined to accept that is because I've seen that in some of these other cases.
sentences.zh: 我之所以倾向于接受这一点，是因为我在其他一些案例中也见过。

sentences.en: Although probably not quite as abrupt as he, and to me at least,
sentences.zh: 虽然可能不像他那样突然，但至少对我来说，

sentences.en: that having seen a lot of savants, when I see some of these acquired savant cases,
sentences.zh: 在见过许多学者症候群患者后，当我看到这些后天获得的案例时，

sentences.en: I don't know if you remember what Derek said about his injury.
sentences.zh: 不知道你是否还记得德里克关于他受伤的描述。

sentences.en: He leaped across the swimming pool for the football,
sentences.zh: 他为了接球跳过游泳池，

sentences.en: and when he came down hard, he heard what sounded like an explosion.
sentences.zh: 落地时重重地撞了一下，听到了一声类似爆炸的声音。

sentences.en: And I miscalculated the depth, obviously, and I hit the upper left side of my face.
sentences.zh: 显然我误判了深度，我的脸左上侧撞到了。

sentences.en: The left side of his face.
In general, in savant syndrome itself, whether congenital or acquired,
sentences.zh: 通常来说，在学者症候群本身，无论是先天的还是后天的，

sentences.en: there tends to be a more left brain injury with right brain compensation.
sentences.zh: 往往表现为左脑受损，而右脑进行补偿。

sentences.en: And the right brain areas of ability that seem to emerge have to do with art, music, and mathematics, actually.
sentences.zh: 而右脑似乎显现出的能力领域，实际上与艺术、音乐和数学有关。

sentences.en: All skills that involve pattern recognition.
sentences.zh: 所有这些技能都涉及模式识别。

sentences.en: At the University of Pennsylvania, cognitive psychologist Scott Barry Kaufman said,
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的认知心理学家斯科特·巴里·考夫曼说，

sentences.en: think about it, these are the skills you might imagine are built into the architecture of the brain.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，这些技能可能就是大脑结构中与生俱来的。

sentences.en: In other words, we might come hardwired for certain kinds of activities.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我们可能天生就具备了进行某些活动的硬件。

sentences.en: This is the insight that helped me see that Derek might not be pulling a prank.
sentences.zh: 正是这一洞见让我明白，德里克可能并不是在恶作剧。

sentences.en: Most of us, in fact, effortlessly learn things.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们大多数人都是毫不费力地学习事物的。

sentences.en: Just like Derek says he never took classes to learn piano,
sentences.zh: 就像德里克说他从未上过钢琴课一样，

sentences.en: you probably didn't take formal lessons to learn your first language.
sentences.zh: 你可能也没有通过正式课程来学习你的第一语言。

sentences.en: The truth is that a lot of things we learn in life were not done deliberately.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们在生活中学习的许多东西并非刻意为之。

sentences.en: When we were very young, in the ages of two and four,
sentences.zh: 当我们还很小，在两到四岁时，

sentences.en: we learned a huge amount of new words
sentences.zh: 我们自动学会了大量的新词汇，

sentences.en: and learned the grammatical structure of our language automatically.
sentences.zh: 并自动掌握了语言的语法结构。

sentences.en: We didn't sit down when we were two years old and say,
sentences.zh: 我们并没有在两岁时坐下来对自己说，

sentences.en: right, I'm going to learn all the grammatical syntax and what it all means.
sentences.zh: 好了，我要开始学习所有的语法句法以及它们的含义了。

sentences.en: And so we have these structures that help us learn.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拥有这些帮助我们学习的结构。

sentences.en: If you look at it this way, most people have skills that might seem savant-like
sentences.zh: 如果你从这个角度看，大多数人拥有的技能，在来自外星的访客看来，

sentences.en: to a visitor from another planet.
sentences.zh: 可能就像学者症候群一样。
我们毫不费力地学会了这些技能。

sentences.en: In fact, it doesn't even feel like learning.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这甚至感觉不像是在学习。

sentences.en: What makes savants unique, in other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，学者症候群患者的独特之处，

sentences.en: is not that their brains do amazing things.
sentences.zh: 并不在于他们的大脑能做惊人的事情。
所有人的大脑都能做惊人的事情。

sentences.en: What's different is that they're demonstrating effortless learning
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，他们展示了这种毫不费力的学习，

sentences.en: in domains that usually call for sustained effort.
sentences.zh: 而这些领域通常需要持续的努力。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not going to tell you you should go out and bang your head
sentences.zh: 当然，我不是要告诉你，你应该跑出去把头撞在

sentences.en: against the floor of a swimming pool to learn to play the piano.
sentences.zh: 游泳池底上来学习弹钢琴。

sentences.en: The vast majority of concussions don't produce an inner genius.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数脑震荡并不会产生内在的天才。
它们往往会带来可怕的后果。

sentences.en: But Derek's story does suggest, even to this card-carrying rationalist,
sentences.zh: 但德里克的故事确实向我们，甚至向我这个理性主义者暗示，

sentences.en: that we have worlds within us, gifts, that we do not realize that we possess.
sentences.zh: 我们内心拥有未曾察觉的世界和天赋。

sentences.en: When I look at these savants, what I see at the core
sentences.zh: 当我审视这些学者症候群患者时，我看到的核心，

sentences.en: that I think offers a lot of inspiration to humanity
sentences.zh: 我认为这为人类提供了很多灵感，

sentences.en: is that they are so motivated.
They are in love with what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 他们热爱自己所做的事情。

sentences.en: It's almost like an extension of who they are.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是他们自身的一种延伸。

sentences.en: To me, that offers a lot of hope or inspires me
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这带来了很多希望，或者说激励了我，

sentences.en: that perhaps all of us can find that vehicle
sentences.zh: 也许我们所有人都能找到那个载体，

sentences.en: that really allows us to sing.
As Derek was playing the piano in NPR Studio One,
sentences.zh: 当德里克在 NPR 一号演播室弹钢琴时，

sentences.en: I noticed there was a wall behind him.
sentences.zh: 我注意到他身后有一面墙。

sentences.en: It had soundproofing, hollow wooden cubes,
sentences.zh: 上面有隔音的空心木块，
每个木块的深度都不同。

sentences.en: Derek had told me that when he plays,
sentences.zh: 德里克曾告诉我，当他演奏时，

sentences.en: he sees squares floating by him.
sentences.zh: 他会看到方块在他面前漂浮。

sentences.en: So I asked him to turn around, look at the wall,
sentences.zh: 所以我让他转过身，看着那面墙，

sentences.en: and tell me what he saw.
I see on this wall, I see these squares.
sentences.zh: 我在这面墙上看到了这些方块。

sentences.en: Some of them have different depths.
sentences.zh: 它们中的一些有不同的深度。

sentences.en: So the full squares almost feel like a whole note to me.
sentences.zh: 所以那些完整的方块对我来说几乎感觉像是一个全音符。

sentences.en: I asked Derek to play the wall for me.
sentences.zh: 我让德里克为我演奏这面墙。

sentences.en: I see low notes because all the depth.
sentences.zh: 我看到了低音，因为所有的深度。

sentences.en: You see the dark ones that are filled in all the way?
sentences.zh: 你看到那些完全填满的深色方块了吗？

sentences.en: They stand out, so I see low notes like...
sentences.zh: 它们很突出，所以我看到了像这样的低音……

sentences.en: Now I'm in the middle boxes.
sentences.zh: 现在我到了中间的方块。

sentences.en: See where I'm at now in those middle boxes?
sentences.zh: 看到我现在在那些中间的方块哪里了吗？

sentences.en: Now we're getting into a whole different thing.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要进入一个完全不同的领域了。

sentences.en: Got any more walls to look at?
So you were just playing the wall?
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才是在弹奏那面墙？

sentences.en: Okay, so imagine that's the music bar.
sentences.zh: 好的，想象一下那是乐谱栏。

sentences.en: So I played the top one.
sentences.zh: 所以我弹了最上面那个。

sentences.en: I'll do it precisely exactly like I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我会完全按照我看到的样子精确地弹奏。

sentences.en: And then it changes to this bar.
and now we're going to move down to the next bar of music.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要移到下一行乐谱。

sentences.en: And we'll go back up to the top.
And then we can make it jazz.
sentences.zh: 然后我们可以把它变成爵士乐。

sentences.en: And I mean, it just goes on and on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它就这样一直持续下去。

sentences.en: And these walls could be dangerous
because I wouldn't want to sleep at all
sentences.zh: 因为如果我家有这样的墙，

sentences.en: if I had walls like this at my house.
Are you telling me that you have never played
sentences.zh: 你是说你以前从来没有弹过

sentences.en: the piece of music you just played for me
sentences.zh: 你刚才为我弹奏的那段音乐吗？

sentences.en: And this third row might even be

sentences.zh: 是一段完全不同的作品。

sentences.en: Those middle rows and those circles in the middle,
sentences.zh: 那些中间的行和中间的圆圈，

sentences.en: that's what these are to me.
Those are rolling patterns to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那些是流动的模式。

sentences.en: And then those chunky ones on the top,
sentences.zh: 还有上面那些厚实的方块，

sentences.en: And it just changes like that suddenly.
And then I moved out of the next one
and it's a whole different flow.

sentences.zh: 以上是音乐家德里克·阿马托，
对于德里克来说，一切都改变了，

sentences.en: when he gained an incredible talent.
sentences.zh: 当他获得了一种不可思议的天赋。

sentences.en: in an exciting new musical direction.
sentences.zh: 一个令人兴奋的音乐新方向。

sentences.en: But sometimes the most valuable moments
are when something's taken away from you.
sentences.zh: 是当你失去某些东西的时候。

sentences.en: you can see a different kind of growth.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到另一种成长。

sentences.en: I was really devastated to lose something
that I was completely in love with

sentences.zh: 我的一切，我真的感到非常崩溃。

sentences.en: such a large part of my life
sentences.zh: 是我生命中很大的一部分

sentences.en: You know, I was first and foremost a violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我首先是一名小提琴手。

sentences.en: My grandmother was an Indian classical violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母是一位印度古典小提琴手。

sentences.en: And so my mom had her old violin
sentences.zh: 所以我妈妈把她那把旧小提琴

sentences.en: in our attic for many years.
Maya's story begins in an attic in Connecticut
sentences.zh: 玛雅的故事始于康涅狄格州的一个阁楼，

sentences.en: Each of my three older siblings
saying that it wasn't cool enough.
And my mom finally gave me the instrument
sentences.zh: 我妈妈最终把琴给了我，

sentences.en: kind of by the tactile sensation
I mean, the wood and the bow.

sentences.zh: 玛雅的母亲对西方古典音乐

sentences.en: but she signed up her daughter
for lessons using the Suzuki method.
The focus was on playing by ear
sentences.zh: 重点在于通过听觉演奏

sentences.en: I had a special schedule at school
sentences.zh: 我在学校有一个特殊的课程表，

sentences.en: to lump all my classes together
so that I'd come a little bit early
and get a little bit more practice in.
And especially with all the traveling,
sentences.zh: 尤其是考虑到所有的奔波，

sentences.en: most days were devoted exclusively to music.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间都专门用于音乐了。

sentences.en: Now the part of her musical education
that was missing was the formal part.
sentences.zh: 缺失的部分是正规训练。

sentences.en: She didn't know how to read music very well,
but she had a fine ear
In the pursuit to find a teacher
who would take her to the next level,
Maya's mother did something quite daring.
sentences.zh: 玛雅的母亲做了一件非常大胆的事。

sentences.en: when it came to my violin life
sentences.zh: 在我的小提琴生涯上尤其如此，

sentences.en: she didn't really have a lot of experience
sentences.zh: 她其实并没有太多经验，

sentences.en: or exposure to the music community
sentences.zh: 也没怎么接触过音乐圈，

sentences.en: and kind of had to innovate
They were in New York one day,
one of the world's most famous

sentences.zh: 也最顶尖的音乐学府之一，

sentences.en: when her mother came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 她妈妈想出了一个主意。

sentences.en: Why don't we just go to Juilliard?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不直接去茱莉亚学院看看呢？
我是说，为什么不呢，对吧？

sentences.en: So we walked into the building
we happened to run into a student in the elevator
sentences.zh: 我们在电梯里碰巧遇到了一名学生，

sentences.en: who studied with a music teacher
and my mom talked to that family in the elevator
sentences.zh: 我妈妈在电梯里和那家人交谈，

sentences.en: Would you mind if we just had about
sentences.zh: 你们介意我们在你们课后

sentences.en: five or ten minutes at the end of your lesson
where Maya could play for your teacher?
sentences.zh: 让玛雅为你们的老师演奏一下吗？

sentences.en: Of course, you know what happened next.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道接下来发生了什么。

sentences.en: Maya played for the other student's music teacher,
sentences.zh: 玛雅为那位学生的老师演奏了，

sentences.en: and got accepted into a summer program.
sentences.zh: 并被录取参加了一个暑期项目。

sentences.en: Soon she was taking classes at Juilliard.
sentences.zh: 很快她就开始在茱莉亚学院上课了。

sentences.en: She was playing with other talented musicians.
